hook: Your workout time says more about you than you think. Are you up at 5 AM chasing gains, squeezing in a workout before work, or training late at night because th
caption:
Your workout time says more about you than you think. Are you up at 5 AM chasing gains, squeezing in a workout before work, or training late at night because that is the only time you have? Every gym has a different character.

But here is the real secret: the best workout time is the one you can stick to. Research suggests performance can vary throughout the day, but consistency, sleep, recovery and your personal schedule matter far more than forcing yourself into someone else's routine.

So what does your workout time say about you? Tag the friend who has a completely unhinged gym schedule.
